name: intercom
description: Work with Intercom contacts and conversations using an access token. Load for contact lookups, searches, and reading conversations.

content.inline:
## Intercom
Calls go through `v/ops/http/get` / `v/ops/http/post` against `https://api.intercom.io` with `bearerSecret: "s/INTERCOM_TOKEN"` and the header `Intercom-Version: 2.11`. The token is a workspace access token (Intercom -> Settings -> Developers -> Developer Hub -> your app -> Authentication). Only the secret reference goes in the request.

Common calls:
- Me / workspace: `GET /me`
- Search contacts: `POST /contacts/search` body `{query: {field: "email", operator: "=", value: "a@b.com"}}`
- One contact: `GET /contacts/{id}`
- List conversations: `GET /conversations?per_page=50`
- One conversation: `GET /conversations/{id}`
- Reply: `POST /conversations/{id}/reply` body `{message_type: "comment"|"note", type: "admin", admin_id, body}`

Rules:
- Check `status`; errors are `{type: "error.list", errors: [{code, message}]}`. 401 = bad token; 429 = rate limited.
- Search is a POST with a query object; simple `GET /contacts` lists without filters. Ids are strings.
